'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Brian Fred LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Mike Honcho
* '''Deck name:''' Mega Shack
* '''Username:''' retwin316
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
